# Santosh Poudel - First-party profile

Canonical profile website: https://santosh2.com.np/
VerifiAI product website: https://santoshpoudel06.com.np/
Profile page: https://santosh2.com.np/me

## Short biography

Santosh Poudel is an AI and web developer from Nepal, a computer engineer, and the founder of VerifiAI. His work includes building websites and exploring tools for AI content authenticity. VerifiAI focuses on helping people assess AI-generated and manipulated digital content.

## Approved profile bios

Short bio: Santosh Poudel (Santosh) is a Nepal-based full-stack web and AI developer building SaaS products, web applications, Discord bots, and AI tools while learning blockchain development.

Long bio: Santosh Poudel (Santosh) is a full-stack web developer and AI developer from Nepal. He builds SaaS products and web applications, and creates Discord bots such as DexBotX, a self-managing moderation bot. He founded VerifiAI, an AI content-detection project, and is learning Ethereum, Sui, and Solana. He shares his work on GitHub, YouTube, and other public social profiles.

Approved name spellings: Santosh Poudel; Santosh; santoshpoudel; सन्तोष पौडेल. Common search misspellings provided for this profile: Santosh Paudel, Santosh Poudle, Santosh Podul, Santosh Poudell, Santosh Pouydal, and Santosh Powdel.

This site is Santosh Poudel's personal portfolio and profile website. The separate santoshpoudel06.com.np domain is the VerifiAI product site. Keep the distinct roles of these live domains clear.

## Work and projects

### VerifiAI

VerifiAI is a project founded by Santosh Poudel that focuses on AI-generated content, manipulated media and digital content authenticity.

Project details: https://santosh2.com.np/projects/verifai
Product site: https://santoshpoudel06.com.np/

AI detection can be uncertain. A detector result should be treated as one signal, not conclusive proof of who created content or whether it is true. Source context and provenance also matter.

### Web development

Santosh Poudel builds websites and digital projects. This website uses Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Review the portfolio and public repositories for first-hand evidence of work; project suitability depends on scope and requirements.

GitHub: https://github.com/santoshpoudelx

### DexBotX

DexBotX is a Discord bot project built by Santosh Poudel. Its documented features include moderation, welcome flows, role automation, AI chat, YouTube and Kick notifications, and an admin dashboard. The project is ongoing, so refer to its project page and product site for current capabilities.

Project details: https://santosh2.com.np/projects/dexbotx
Project site: https://dexbotx.vercel.app/
Article: https://santosh2.com.np/blog/building-dexbotx-discord-bot

### SaaS development

Santosh Poudel writes about building SaaS products through focused workflows, clear user experiences, reliability, and iterative improvement. This article describes his approach without claiming market demand or client results.

Article: https://santosh2.com.np/blog/building-a-saas-as-a-developer-in-nepal

### Blockchain learning

Santosh Poudel is learning Ethereum, Sui, and Solana. His article describes this as an active learning journey and does not claim professional blockchain expertise or completed deployments.

Article: https://santosh2.com.np/blog/learning-ethereum-sui-solana-from-nepal

### AI-generated content detection

Santosh Poudel founded VerifiAI, an AI content-detection project. Its portfolio description focuses on source review and provenance context. Detector outputs should be treated as uncertain signals, not conclusive proof of authorship or truth. This article does not claim undocumented implementation details or accuracy results.

Article: https://santosh2.com.np/blog/how-verifiai-approaches-ai-content-detection
